rationale: uswin-claude-agentic: train_n=800, val_n=200, epochs=40, batch_size=2, lr=0.0002, uswin_c=32, swin_window=8, swin_heads=8, grad_clip=1.0, max_train_s=1000, seed=42, rationale=ITER-15. SIX-BOX (NUMBERS): (1) READ data-scaling series (all c32/bs1/lr2e-4): tn200 0.8464(ep40) / tn400 0.8615(ep26) / tn800 0.8696(ep13,BEST) / tn1600 0.8614(ep7). Data helped up to tn800 then REVERSED at tn1600: iter-14 tn1600 hr=0.861407 backstop ep7 <= tn800's 0.8696. So the backstop epoch-cut FINALLY outweighed the data gain at tn1600 -> tn800/ep13 is the budget-optimal DATA volume. iter-13 tn800 hit the backstop at ep13 with loss still ~5e-7 (NOT plateaued) -> tn800 may itself be EPOCH-LIMITED. (2) FAILURE MODE / limiter: at the tn800 data optimum, the binding constraint is EPOCHS (only 13 fit at bs1 because bs1 = 800 steps/epoch). To get MORE epochs on the same 800-scene data within the wall, I can trade gradient DENSITY for epochs via a larger batch. bs=2 at tn800 = 400 steps/epoch = HALF the per-epoch cost -> ~2x the epochs (~ep26 instead of 13) on the SAME best data. This is the epochs-vs-density tradeoff tested AT the data optimum (bs1 won that tradeoff at tn200 in iter-7, but there epochs were not backstop-limited; at tn800 epochs ARE the binding constraint, so more-epochs-via-bs2 may now win). (3) ONE KNOB: batch_size 1 -> 2 (at tn800); hold everything else at iter-13 BEST-config (tn800, c32, ep=40, lr=2e-4, win=8, heads=8, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42). (4) HYPOTHESIS: tn800/bs1 was epoch-limited at ep13 (loss still falling); bs2 doubles the achievable epochs on the 800-scene data (~ep26) and that extra training more than compensates for bs2's coarser gradients, lifting hr above 0.8696. FALSIFIER (NUMBERS): if hr <= 0.8696 at tn800/bs2, then gradient DENSITY (bs1) matters more than the extra epochs even at the data optimum (consistent with iter-7 bs1>bs2), i.e. tn800/bs1/ep13 (iter-13, 0.8696) is the robust optimum -> iter-16 locks that config and does a confirmation/stage-style rerun or a small lr tweak (lr 1.5e-4 for a touch more stability to squeeze the ep13 basin). (5) 20-min budget via max_train_s=1000 backstop; val_n=200; tn800; expandable_segments OOM-guard. (6) STRICT SERIAL: rm iter-15 obs pre-dispatch; iter_wait.sh gate before iter-16.
